subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: What product scope should own the remaining native Control UI notification, cron action popup, and context-pressure prompt work for this issue?
rationale: Current main has enough partial infrastructure that the next change is not a mechanical bug fix; maintainers need to choose the notification architecture, action semantics, and split against related open items before implementation.

options.title: Scope the notification architecture first
options.body: Define a generic Control UI notification queue and then layer cron-result actions and context-pressure prompts on that shared surface.

options.title: Keep context inline and narrow cron UX
options.body: Leave context pressure as the existing composer control and open narrower work only for cron finished popups and snooze/reschedule behavior.

options.title: Defer native popups
options.body: Keep Web Push/settings and existing cron/history UI as the supported path until a broader Control UI action model is approved.

recommendation.title: Scope the notification architecture first
recommendation.body: Define a generic Control UI notification queue and then layer cron-result actions and context-pressure prompts on that shared surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried the prior review and recent cron notification-routing work, making him the best available routing owner for the product-scope decision.
